newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston to buy finance firm for $40 million.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston to buy finance firm for $40 million.

text.p: BankBoston said Tuesday it agreed to acquire GBFC Inc., a speciality finance company from Gordon Brothers for $40 million.
GBFC is an asset-based lender that does business exclusively with retailers. Boston-based Gordon Brothers offers a variety of restructuring services to the retail industry.
BankBoston said GBFC's 23 employees, including its management, would continue to work together as a separate unit of BankBoston.
The bank did not say when it expected the transaction to be completed.
